name: Aalto Two-Seater Sofa
description: Compact two-seater with a slim oak frame and tapered legs. Suits small living rooms and apartment balconies-turned-lounges.

name: Aalto Three-Seater Sofa
description: The three-seater version of the Aalto. Same slim frame; needs a wall run of at least 230 cm.

name: Kyoto Low Sofa
description: Low-slung seat height of 38 cm. Reads calm and grounded; pairs with low tables.

name: Bombay Chesterfield
description: Deep buttoned back and rolled arms. A statement piece for a formal drawing room.

name: Meridian Modular Sofa
description: L-shaped modular with a reversible chaise. Ships as three units.

name: Corbu Leather Loveseat
description: Two cushions, exposed chrome. Ages well; expect visible patina within a year.

name: Nordic Extending Dining Table
description: Seats six comfortably, eight with the leaf extended to 230 cm.

name: Malabar Dining Table
description: Hand-finished solid teak with a live edge. Seats six.

name: Kyoto Round Dining Table
description: Round four-seater. The pedestal base leaves legroom clear.

name: Slab Dining Table
description: Seats eight. Very heavy; two people needed to move it.

name: Tiffin Bistro Table
description: Two-seater bistro table sized for a kitchen corner or breakfast nook.

name: Wishbone Dining Chair
material: solid beech with paper cord seat
description: Light enough to move one-handed. Sold singly.

name: Kyoto Dining Chair
description: Low back, woven seat. Works at both dining and desk height.

name: Bentwood Cafe Chair
description: Stackable. Commonly used at kitchen counters and bistro tables.

name: Kanthi Accent Chair
description: Woven cane back with a loose cushion. Reads warm against plain walls.

name: Corbu Lounge Chair
description: Low lounge chair with a matching ottoman available separately.

name: Counter Stool 65
description: Counter-height stool. Also available at 75 cm bar height on request.

name: Kyoto Platform Bed
description: Queen platform bed with an integrated floating side ledge. Low profile, no headboard.

name: Aalto Bed
description: Queen size with a slim padded headboard.

name: Haveli Four-Poster Bed
description: King size four-poster with carved posts. Needs a ceiling height of at least 280 cm.

name: Slab Bed
description: Double bed, the cheapest frame we carry. Flat-packs into two cartons.

name: Bombay Storage Bed
description: Queen with hydraulic under-bed storage.

name: Kyoto Side Table
description: Single open shelf. Height matches the Kyoto Platform Bed.

name: Aalto Nightstand
description: One drawer, one open shelf.

name: Drum Side Table
description: Hand-hammered brass drum. Marks easily; wipe dry.

name: Slab Coffee Table
description: Rectangular, low. Heavy for its size.

name: Kyoto Low Table
description: Deliberately low to sit with the Kyoto Low Sofa.

name: Malabar Nesting Tables
description: Pair of nesting tables in solid teak.

name: Aalto Wardrobe
description: Two-door with a hanging rail and four shelves.

name: Walnut Wardrobe
description: Three-door sliding wardrobe with an internal drawer bank.

name: Haveli Almirah
description: Carved two-door almirah with a full-length mirror inside.

name: Paper Pendant Lamp
description: Diffuse overhead light. Ships flat.

name: Kyoto Floor Lamp
description: Warm, low-glare floor lamp. Reading-height shade.

name: Brass Task Lamp
description: Adjustable arm table lamp for a bedside or desk.

name: Jaali Pendant
description: Pierced brass shade that throws a patterned light onto the ceiling.

name: Kilim Rug 170x240
description: Flatweave wool kilim. Reversible; no pile.

name: Loop Rug 200x300
description: Low-loop pile in a plain greige. Hides footfall well.

name: Jute Rug 160x230
description: Hardwearing jute. Rough underfoot; usually used under a dining table.

name: Aalto Sideboard
description: Three doors and an internal drawer. Also used as a TV unit.

name: Slab Media Unit
description: Low media unit with cable routing at the back.

name: Malabar Bookcase
description: Five fixed shelves in solid teak. Very heavy once loaded.
